title: Story PIL Flavor Selector
description: Deterministic mapper from creator answers (commercial use, derivatives, minting fee, revenue share) to a Story Protocol Programmable IP License flavor (Non-Commercial Social Remixing, Commercial Use, Commercial Remix) with the full PILTerms struct. Selection only, not legal advice. Zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: pil_flavor_selector
mcp_tool_definition.description: Maps creator answers (commercial use, derivatives allowed, minting fee, revenue share) to a Story Protocol Programmable IP License flavor (non_commercial_social_remixing, commercial_use, commercial_remix) and emits the full PILTerms struct. Deterministic. Use when a creator or agent needs to pick a PIL flavor before registering IP on Story Protocol. Selection only, not legal advice.

commercial_use.description: Allow commercial use (no = Non-Commercial Social Remixing)

derivatives_allowed.description: Allow derivatives (with commercial: yes = Commercial Remix, no = Commercial Use)

rev_share_pct.description: Creator-set commercial revenue share percent (Commercial Remix only)
